data.notes: The report gets the core diagnosis right. It tags the deal Value proof, uses the rep's own price-match answer to undercut 'we lost on price', and shows that the champion was never equipped with a Fernbrook-specific business case: the declined three-month analysis and the deck sent instead of a one-pager. Its weaknesses are small. The trigger insight never notes that the pain was owned by someone who couldn't sign. The rep's 'more room on the rate' claim is labelled opinion only indirectly (as 'We lost on price'), not in the Decided section.
